subject: Short-term quota uplift + capped overrun pricing — BrightFoundry
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@brightfoundry.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Kenna Park <kenna.sales@brightfoundry.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term throughput uplift & cap on overrun rates

Hi Vivek,

Quick ask from our side — BrightFoundry is going to run a major feature launch the week of Apr 11. Our traffic projection shows a ~5x token spike for ~72 hours. We need: (1) a provisional quota increase for the launch window, and (2) a firm cap on the overrun rate (or a blended rate) so our finance team can approve the budget.

Current committed tier won't cover the burst; we prefer a short-term elevated ceiling rather than switching to a higher commit. Can you outline pricing for a temporary 3-day uplift (est. +350M tokens) and any one-time credits you can provide? Also include PO flow — procurement will need a simple amendment or PO attachment.

Attaching our preliminary PO template so you can see their standard fields.

Thanks — appreciate a fast turnaround.

Alex Morgan
Head of Platform, BrightFoundry
alex@brightfoundry.ai

Attachment: BF_PO_Q1_2027.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@brightfoundry.ai>
Cc: Kenna Park <kenna.sales@brightfoundry.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throughput uplift & cap on overrun rates

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the PO template. We're happy to support the launch. High level proposal below:

Summary offer (provisional, pending internal approval):
- Temporary uplift window: Apr 11 00:00 UTC – Apr 13 23:59 UTC (72 hours)
- Elevated quota: +400M tokens (safety buffer)
- Blended overrun rate during window: $0.0035 / token (discounted from standard overrun $0.0050)
- One-time launch credit: $2,500 applied against overrun charges if usage exceeds the blended estimate
- No change to committed tier or long-term billing; this is an amendment to cover the launch window only

Procurement flow: we can provide a one-page amendment (attached) that references the existing contract and lists the uplift, blended rate, and dates. You can sign via DocuSign.

I attached the draft amendment and included Ben and Irene on the thread to finalize approvals on our side. If that looks reasonable I'll route for sign-off and generate a DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Vivek
Senior Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-temp-quota-amendment.pdf (PDF stub)
